selected_evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL streaming replication configured: node1 primary, node2/node3 standbys
selected_evidence.summary: PostgreSQL 16 installed and initialized on node1; replication role, wal_level, pg_hba, and firewall configured; node2/node3 cloned via pg_basebackup -R with standby.signal and primary_conninfo generated, then started.

selected_evidence.requirement: Standbys are streaming and read-only; primary shows both connected replicas
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 lists both node2 and node3 in 'streaming' state; pg_is_in_recovery() is true on both standbys; an INSERT attempt on node2 is rejected with 'read-only transaction'.

selected_evidence.requirement: Changes committed on the primary are visible on both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: An INSERT executed on node1 (primary) appears in the repl_test table queried on both node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 31b01b46...; reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; post-restart boot_id 73effaec... (changed); postgresql active, not in recovery, both standbys reconnected streaming, firewall rule persisted; a post-restart INSERT on node1 replicated to node2 and node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id e31962a9...; reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; post-restart boot_id 57022f67... (changed); postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery=true, repl_test data intact, and node1's pg_stat_replication shows node2 reconnected streaming.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 54bd1c3e...; reboot acknowledged then connection dropped; post-restart boot_id 3d9f50bd... (changed); postgresql active, pg_is_in_recovery=true, repl_test data intact, and node1's pg_stat_replication shows node3 reconnected streaming.
